runbooks.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Flush & Dynamic Capacity Scaling
runbooks.author: Jordan Patel
runbooks.description: Diagnostic probes connection pool exhaustion, kills zombie client connections, reconfigures PgBouncer pool ceiling, and validates response latency.

steps.name: Inspect PgBouncer Pool Saturation & Client Wait Queues
steps.command: pgbouncer-cli --cmd "SHOW POOLS; SHOW CLIENTS WHERE state='waiting'"
steps.description: Checks current active, waiting, and idle connections against max limits.

steps.name: Terminate Idle-in-Transaction Zombie Sessions
steps.command: psql -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle in transaction' AND state_change < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes';"
steps.description: Safely purges hung connections holding table row locks.

steps.name: Dynamically Scale PgBouncer Pool Reserve & Worker Limit
steps.description: Expands database proxy concurrency ceiling without restarting primary postgres daemon.

steps.name: Execute Synthetic Canary Health Check & Latency Probe
steps.description: Runs 50 concurrent test transactions to verify healthy latency < 25ms.

runbooks.title: Checkout Service Canary Traffic Reroute & Rolling Rollback
runbooks.author: Sarah Chen
runbooks.description: Isolates degraded canary pod replicas, reroutes upstream traffic to stable blue deployment, and purges stale response buffers.

steps.name: Assess Canary Error Distribution vs Baseline
steps.description: Confirms error rate disparity between v2.4.1 (canary) and v2.4.0 (stable).

steps.name: Shift 100% Ingress Traffic to Stable Blue Cluster
steps.description: Immediately removes bleeding edge pods from user-facing traffic routing.

steps.name: Perform Graceful Rolling Rollback of Canary Replicas
steps.description: Restores previous known good container image and state.

steps.name: Flush Gateway Connection Keep-Alive Pools
steps.description: Ensures zero hung TCP streams remain attached to terminated pods.

runbooks.title: Redis Distributed Node Sentinel Failover & Buffer Reset
runbooks.author: Alex Mercer
runbooks.description: Orchestrates zero-downtime leader election across Redis Sentinel quorum and clears dirty eviction locks.

steps.name: Check Replication Lag & Quorum Health
steps.description: Ensures minimum 2 of 3 Sentinel monitors agree on node status.

steps.name: Trigger Graceful Failover to Hot Standby Replica
steps.description: Promotes replica-02 to master and updates client DNS pointer.

steps.name: Verify Client Read/Write Consistency
steps.description: Validates sub-millisecond response on new master node.

postMortems.title: Post-Mortem: Redis Node Memory Pressure & Sudden Cache Eviction Spike
postMortems.author: Jordan Patel
postMortems.executiveSummary: On Oct 27, 2026, the Redis Distributed Cache node experienced memory saturation due to an unexpiring payload key deployed in the recommendation microservice. LRU eviction dropped active user sessions for 18 minutes before a hot-patch and key TTL ceiling was established.
postMortems.impactSummary: 850 user sessions degraded; checkout cache miss rate peaked at 34%. No permanent data loss.
postMortems.rootCauseAnalysis: Recommendation microservice update omitted default Redis TTL configuration, defaulting keys to persistent storage.
lessonsLearned: Mandatory linter rule in CI to enforce TTL parameters on all Redis SET commands.
Implement automated maxmemory-policy guardrails in Redis cluster staging.
Add alert threshold at 80% memory saturation before LRU eviction begins.

actionItems.task: Add PR linter for Redis cache TTL parameters
Set maxmemory soft alert threshold to 75%
Audit all microservices for persistent Redis key usage

postMortems.title: Post-Mortem: Database Connection Pool Saturation on postgres-primary
postMortems.author: Alex Mercer
postMortems.executiveSummary: On 10/27/2026, PostgreSQL Primary Cluster experienced a P1 incident lasting 35 minutes. Impact radius included All checkout, customer accounts, and order fulfillment APIs. Estimated users impacted: ~14,200.
postMortems.impactSummary: Duration: 35 minutes. Peak latency observed on PostgreSQL Primary Cluster. SLA Target: 30m (Status: Breached).
postMortems.detectionMethod: Automated synthetic probe and latency anomaly detection.
postMortems.rootCauseAnalysis: Underlying resource saturation triggered upstream thread starvation across microservice ingress boundaries.
